population: Public games first seen in a third-party sampled feed over 152 days; includes free and paid titles
unit: Unique monitored public project identifier ever featured, sampled feature-rank sighting and dated day; never a paid order
period: Early January through June 11 2026; published June 12 2026
sample_frame: 118,017 first-seen public games in Pelipulssi independent periodic feed snapshots
interpretations: Observed ever-featured incidence is conditional on the selected monitor frame, not an all-store editorial acceptance rate.
A selected game's 652 sightings are not a fraction of all game listing impressions; global slot occupancy counts are not known.
The feature catalog extends below the first viewport; presence in a long catalog is not proof of homepage top-row exposure.
A game entering in February has more follow-up days than later entries, so the 8 of 296 statistic must not be treated as a representative survival probability.
Editorial selection and existing audiences confound any observational rank-to-sales comparison.
limitations: Page and feed observations are periodic; continuous slot visibility is not directly measured.
The monitor includes free alpha releases, varied genres, incumbent creators and unverified coverage.
Rank is not a verified impression to a human and neither rank nor rating proves a paid unit.
No merchant API, purchase records or personal account data was used.
